skill_name: Create a dance routine to the given song.
workflow: The dance routine for Uptown Funk begins with a jump-loop and a drop into the groove. To the beat of the music, the dancers start clapping and kicking their arms downward. With hands wider apart, they start jiving with a combination of salsa and hip hop dance moves. As the song builds up, they bring the intensity up with arm circles and hip shimmies, while keeping the feet and legs moving together.
